# Golden Compass

> Kenya-focused market analysis, investing education and demo investing. Legal disclosures are pending review.

Real payments and order execution are currently disabled while safeguards are upgraded. The education assistant is temporarily unavailable. Existing account records are preserved.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): Existing investors sign in to their Golden Compass account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new Golden Compass investor account.
- [Dividend tracking guide](/guides/dividend-tracking): How pool distributions are calculated, paid into your wallet, and tracked over time.
